paragraphs: Rabbi Yeshayah, student of Rabbi Chanina ben Dosa.

Hyman cites Yalkut, Bo, section 186, for the account that Yeshayah undertook eighty-eight fasts over the question of why the dog merited to utter song. Hyman adds that the account is printed in Yeshayah’s name in all prayer books before Perek Shirah.

notes.text: פ״ח is eighty-eight fasts, not a Taanit chapter citation. The claim about all prayer books is Hyman’s and has not been independently surveyed.
The consulted Yalkut locates the account at remez 187 and gives eighty with a bracketed five. The consulted Perek Shirah gives eighty-five. Hyman cites remez 186 and gives eighty-eight.
